verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a first-party Sandbox Mode, a mail_settings parameter that validates a Mail Send request without delivering the email, so the core test-mode capability exists. There is no evidence that sandboxed sends fire events (e.g., to the Event Webhook), and no test API keys or sandbox domain are documented. missing for 10: evidence that sandbox sends fire webhook events, test API keys or sandbox domain, CI/agent-safety documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test sends without delivering real email — a sandbox domain, test mode, or test API keys that accept messages and fire events, safe for CI and agents

citations.quote: Sandbox mode is an optional parameter within mail_settings that validates a Mail Send request without delivering the email.
